verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents self-hosted deployment of its open-source Airbyte Core into any Kubernetes cluster, or anywhere Docker runs. That lets a user decide where the platform and its data live, but the evidence never describes region or residency selection as such. missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency selection for Airbyte Cloud, documented residency guarantees or compliance statements, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This installation guide walks through how to deploy Airbyte into _any_ kubernetes cluster.
abctl makes it easy to run Airbyte anywhere Docker is running.
This quickstart guides you through deploying a local instance of Airbyte Core, Airbyte's open source product.
